note: payload = packet bytes with opcode, WITHOUT the 2-byte length header and WITHOUT encryption/checksum. Integers in fields are signed Java values, byte arrays are hex strings (keys ending in _hex), strings are the Java strings (non-ASCII and surrogate pairs included; the wire format is UTF-16LE code units with a 0x0000 terminator). A variant with produced_by = replay was not made by the real class (see its what). All other variants come from the real Java class.
